title: NautiBuoy Rentals Virginia
specs: Electric personal watercraft with silent operation
Operator must be at least 18 years old with government-issued photo ID showing date of birth
Virginia boating safety education certificate or driver's license required, uploaded during booking and presented at check-in
Signed liability waiver and completed safety training required
Maximum 2 riders per watercraft with combined weight limit of 350 lbs
Must wear U.S. Coast Guard-approved life jacket and engine cutoff lanyard at all times
No alcohol or drug use; must be physically capable and not impaired
Maximum 2 riders per watercraft including operator
includes: Properly sized U.S. Coast Guard-approved life jackets provided with every rental
Mandatory safety briefing and operational training prior to rental
blurb: Guests rent electric personal watercraft and operate them on the water following Virginia law and company safety rules. Rentals include mandatory safety briefing and operational training. Operators must be 18 or older and follow all safety and legal requirements.
extraNote: No refunds for rentals ended due to suspected impairment or rule violations · Rentals may be delayed, shortened, or canceled due to unsafe weather conditions at staff discretion · Late returns may incur additional hourly charges · Violations of rules or failure to follow staff instructions may end rental without refund · Operator accepts full responsibility for all actions, damages, or injuries during rental
